name: colWeightedSds
title: Weighted variance and weighted standard deviation

origin.description: Computes a weighted standard deviation for each column of a matrix.
origin.usage:
colWeightedSds(x, w = NULL, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, na.rm = FALSE,
  ..., useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: A vector of weights, one per row.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The square root of colWeightedVars. A negative column variance becomes NaN.
origin.value: A numeric vector of length equal to the number of selected columns.

translation.description: Computes a weighted standard deviation for each column of a matrix.
translation.usage:
colWeightedSds(x, w=None, rows=None, cols=None, na_rm=False,
  center=None, use_names=True)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A 2-d numeric array whose axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. None gives every row weight 1.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based row subscripts. None selects every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based column subscripts. None selects every column.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If True, missing values in a column are skipped. This is na.rm in R.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Optional center passed to every column. None estimates the center on that column.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for the R argument useNames. The result is a plain float64 vector.

translation.details: The square root of colWeightedVars. R's NA stays R's NA. A negative variance becomes NaN.
translation.value: A float64 vector with one value per selected column.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.weightedvar import colWeightedSds

colWeightedSds(np.arange(1, 13, dtype=float).reshape((3, 4), order="F"))
